set.body:
Exercise the deposit-to-transfer journey using two isolated catalogs and object stores plus a client that relies only on the published contract and manifest format.

Acceptance criteria

1. Using a source account with the appropriate disclosure authority, discover and export a fixed release and a prepared restricted view. Verify allowed paths, sizes, digests, directories and field visibility with an independent checker.
2. With the source unavailable, verify and accept each package under the receiver’s named custodian. Re-read and compare all permitted bytes and origin records. The source’s private parent, excluded paths and grants remain undisclosed.
3. A corrupted package fails before acceptance. Repeating a valid transfer has the documented idempotent outcome.
4. End access at the source and demonstrate independent current access at the receiver. End the receiver grant and verify further receiver delivery is denied.

Verification

Two packaged installations, separately generated identities, frozen expected manifests and positive/negative client transcripts.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: INT04: Prove offline exchange with an independent client and two installations
